    Every yard, included

    1. 01The meadow, all daySetup at 10, last song at 11. No one else books the hill that day.
    2. 02A draped frame tentSized to your guest list, with sheer curtains tied back to the view.
    3. 03Crossback chairs and farm tablesLinens, too. No rental hunt, no delivery fees.
    4. 04Bistro lights and lanternsWarm string lights inside, lantern path to the parking lot.
    5. 05Wine-barrel cocktail tablesSet out on the lawn for cocktail hour, as in the photos.
    6. 06A getting-ready cottageMirrors, natural light and coffee for the morning.
    7. 07Bonfire and s'moresThe fire pit is lit after dark for the late-night crowd.
    8. 08Parking and a meadow shuttleA golf-cart shuttle carries grandparents up from the lot.
    9. 09A day-of coordinatorOne person who knows the hill and runs the timeline.

    Make it a weekend

    Oneonta, the City of the Hills

    Your guests come for a day and stay for three. Tap a place on the map.

    Getting here

    • New York City about 3.5 hours by car, or Trailways bus to Oneonta
    • Albany airport (ALB) about 1 hour 15 minutes
    • Binghamton airport (BGM) about 1 hour
    • Syracuse airport (SYR) about 1 hour 45 minutes

    Where guests stay

    • Oneonta hotels off I-88, 10 to 15 minutes away, with room blocks
    • Cooperstown inns including the Otesaga on Otsego Lake
    • Farmhouse rentals in the hills for the whole wedding party
    • Bell tents on the meadow for the couple's closest friends

    Before and after

    • Welcome drinks on Main Street in downtown Oneonta
    • Morning-after brunch back on the hill, or by the lake
    • A Cooperstown day for the baseball fans in the family
    • Leaf-peeping drives through the hollows in October
